name: win_route
description: Found by exhaustive search of the slice rules (every player move and target, all turns). Step diagonally into lane 4, cross into lane 5 on turn 3 so the first exchange with the lane-4 enemy happens on a player-first turn (both drop to 1 HP); on turn 4 the lane-2 enemy holds the first enemy slot of the attack order but has no target, so the player's second arrow kills the lane-4 enemy before it shoots again. Then run diagonally to column 7 lane 2, arriving on turn 7, the same turn the lane-2 enemy reaches column 0: both sides lose, ties go to the player. Search result: no other kind of win exists under these rules (no elimination win, no clean back-row win).
target_format: [col, lane] zero-based, or null = hold fire / no target
